what: Comcast sells broadband, mobile and television service in the United States under Xfinity and in Europe under Sky. It also owns NBCUniversal: the NBC network, Universal film studios, the Peacock streaming service and Universal theme parks.
customers: Households and businesses buying internet and TV, advertisers, cinema audiences and theme park visitors.
money: the larger part and most of the profit
broadband, wireless, video and voice under Xfinity, Sky and Comcast Business
NBCUniversal television, film, Peacock and theme parks
moat: Cable networks already run past most homes in its footprint; building a competing network costs billions, and broadband is the service households cancel last.
risks: Broadband subscribers are falling as fixed wireless and fibre take share
Debt of about $87 billion is large even for a cable company
Peacock loses money against much larger streaming rivals
Theme parks are discretionary spending that falls in a recession
opportunities: Xfinity Mobile adds revenue per household at low incremental cost
The new Epic Universe park in Orlando adds capacity and admissions
A dividend yield above 5% and heavy buybacks return most free cash flow
watch: Net broadband subscriber additions, the number investors react to most.
